headlines.title: Surging Earnings Estimates Signal Upside for Regeneron (REGN) Stock
headlines.summary: Regeneron (REGN) shares have started gaining and might continue moving higher in the near term, as indicated by solid earnings estimate revisions.

headlines.title: REGN Q2 Deep Dive: Pipeline Progress and Product Momentum Drive Outperformance
headlines.summary: Biotech company Regeneron (NASDAQ:REGN) reported revenue ahead of Wall Street’s expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 16.7% year on year to $4.29 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $14.29 per share was 40.1% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

headlines.title: Sanofi to ‘rebuild trust’ with Regeneron; Apnimed adds to string of ‘upsized’ biotech IPOs
headlines.summary: Sanofi wants to broaden the company’s productive partnership with Regeneron, its CEOs said. Elsewhere, Bristol Myers delayed two anticipated study readouts and a Shionogi-backed startup went public.

headlines.title: Regeneron Awards $150,000 to Winners of the 2026 Regeneron Prize for Creative Innovation
headlines.summary: Early-career scientists from New York University, Stanford University and Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute were recognized for their ambitious "dream project" proposals TARRYTOWN, N.Y., July 31, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Regeneron Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (NASDAQ: REGN) today announced the recipients of the 2026 Regeneron Prize for Creative Innovation (“the Regeneron Prize”).

headlines.title: Regeneron (REGN) Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
headlines.summary: Revenue surged 17% as Dupixent and EYLEA HD posted record sales.

description: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals, Inc. discovers, invents, develops, manufactures, and commercializes medicines to treat various diseases worldwide. The company develops product candidates to treat eye, allergic and inflammatory, cardiovascular, metabolic, neurological, infectious, and rare diseases; and cancer, hematologic conditions. It also offers EYLEA injections for wet age-related macular degeneration and diabetic macular edema; myopic choroidal neovascularization; diabetic retinopathy; neovascular glaucoma; retinopathy of prematurity; Dupixent injection to treat atopic dermatitis and asthma; Libtayo injection for metastatic or locally advanced cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma; Praluent injection to treat heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia (HoFH); and Kevzara solution for rheumatoid arthritis. It has license and collaboration agreement with Bayer for the development and commercialization of EYLEA 8 mg and EYLEA; Alnylam Pharmaceuticals, Inc. to discover, develop, and commercialize RNAi therapeutics for diseases by addressing therapeutic disease targets expressed in the eye and central nervous system; Intellia Therapeutics, Inc. to advance CRISPR/Cas9 gene-editing technology for in vivo therapeutic development for therapies focused on neurological and muscular diseases; Hansoh Pharmaceuticals Group Company Limited to acquire development and commercial rights for HS-20094, a dual GLP-1/GIP receptor; and Tessera Therapeutics, Inc. develops and commercializes TSRA-196, an investigational gene editing therapy for Alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency. Additionally, the company has a strategic collaboration with Telix Pharmaceuticals Limited to develop and commercialize radiopharmaceutical therapies. It also has a strategic collaboration with CytomX Therapeutics, Inc. to create conditionally-activated bispecific cancer therapies. The company was incorporated in 1988 and is based in Tarrytown, New York.
